definition: Change data capture reads ongoing changes from a source data store so they can be replicated.
A DMS endpoint holds connection, type and location information for a data store.
A full load copies existing source data to a target.
Replication latency is the delay between changes in a source and their replication.
A database schema defines database objects such as tables, views and functions.
A DMS replication instance reads data from the source and loads it into the target.
